candidate_receipt_required_rules.false: current locked fallback baseline glyph rows already present in the runtime
candidate_receipt_required_rules.true: any extended candidate whose runtime binding depends on rendered bitmap scoring

contract.candidate_receipt_required_runtime_rule: Runtime selector must not bind candidate-only extended rows (candidate_receipt_required=true) when the receipts file at candidate_receipt_input is absent. Locked fallback baseline rows (candidate_receipt_required=false) remain bindable in the absence of the receipts file. FL-4208 step #24 forbids adding FL-4131 atlas admission code as part of this contract; admission is gated downstream by the FL-4131 pipeline.
contract.description: Foliage-only FL-4208 palette schema consumed by the FL-4184 compositor foliage owner.
contract.no_script_family_intuition: No palette row may bind a glyph from script-family intuition; every binding must trace either to a locked fallback baseline (candidate_receipt_required=false) or to a rendered-bitmap scoring receipt (candidate_receipt_required=true, candidate_receipt_id set).
